goals.title: Omega MCP server (OmegaReach milestone 1)
goals.description: An MCP stdio server written in Omega that compiles and runs .om with the pinned seeded omc in a bwrap+prlimit sandbox and answers error and keyword lookups from data checked against the pinned source.

milestones.description: initialize, tools/list and tools/call compile/run/explain_error/lookup over stdio; smoke session, reference oracle and 4 trust gates (state read, fork bomb, infinite loop, 10 GiB write) pass on the host with negative controls
CI on ubuntu-24.04-arm runs the smoke, reference and trust gates
Replace bwrap and prlimit with Omega host words for namespaces, mounts and rlimits
